projectDesc.p: RELS 398 / ENGL 398 collaborative digital scholarly edition demonstration. Encoded according to TEI P5 Guidelines using the msdesc.rng schema. Modules 1 through 9 encoding layers (metadata, facsimile, diplomatic transcription, orthographic regularization, linguistic markup, and named entities) are consolidated.

revisionDesc.change: Consolidated Modules 1 through 9 layers for collaborative Git workflow demonstration.
